description: The sixteen named LoopSpec triggers and their honest capability axes. Counts are computed by bin/fm-loopspec.sh triggers --summary, never stored here, so no figure in this file can go stale. A complete description is not an implementation: 'specified' is true for all sixteen and says nothing about whether anything runs.
source: data/loop-engineering-commission-2026-08-02.md:118 is the verbatim enumeration. The capability columns are transcribed from data/capability-substrate-audit-loopspec-substrate/report.md findings 2, 3 and 5 (Matrix A, B and C).

axes.specified: The trigger is named in the canonical sixteen-trigger enumeration.
axes.detector_implemented: A detector exists at HEAD that turns the real-world condition into a durable wake. True only when detector_status is 'implemented'.
axes.deterministically_selectable: A LoopSpec can be chosen from this trigger's facts with no semantic judgment. False whenever a judgment call is required, and permanently false where ruled so.
axes.execution_path_implemented: A LoopSpec execution path exists that consumes this trigger end to end.
axes.verified: That end-to-end path has been proven by witnessed execution, not by description or claim.
axes.enabled: This trigger may currently drive a LoopSpec in this home.

detector_status_values.implemented: A detector exists, is armed in production, and emits a durable wake.
detector_status_values.partial: Something related exists but is not an event detector for this trigger.
detector_status_values.generic_unpopulated: A generic mechanism exists with zero sources registered, so nothing is detected.

constraints: check_slot: the watcher's PR poll is one program and one network call. merge-conflict-appears cannot be armed separately from the PR-merged poll, and neither can coexist with another check on the same task.

ruled_never_deterministic: review-posted, issue-created, phase-completed and model-provider-unavailable may never be actuated deterministically. The selection-determinism ruling keeps a deterministic filter plus a small judgment call, and route selection stays a decision firstmate makes.
empty_set_is_not_a_pass: an absent check-run set is no evidence at all and must never read as a pass. This bounds ci-passes.
no_bound_no_actuation: no trigger may be enabled while its non-terminating case cannot be named, which requires a declared budget and no-progress rule.

triggers.name: PR opened
triggers.determinism_note: Requires choosing a reviewer or lens.
triggers.note: Firstmate learns a PR exists from the worker's own report line, which is a claim rather than a detected event.

triggers.name: Commit pushed
triggers.determinism_note: Requires judging whether this is the expected change.

triggers.name: Review posted
triggers.determinism_note: Review findings are prose, so triage is judgment.
triggers.note: The review-repair loop has no declared bound, so its non-terminating case cannot currently be named.

triggers.name: CI fails
triggers.note: No fleet-side detector. The validation pipeline watches CI only inside its own run.

triggers.name: CI passes
triggers.determinism_note: Deterministic only while the empty check-run set is excluded, because an empty set is no evidence and must never read as a pass.
triggers.note: Acting on this trigger reaches a merge decision, which is the captain's under hard rule 2.

triggers.name: Merge conflict appears
triggers.determinism_note: The conflicting state is an exact forge fact.
triggers.note: The one trigger of the sixteen that exists natively. Its detector shares one program and one network call with the PR-merged poll and occupies the only check slot. GitLab merge requests read only state and never emit this trigger.

triggers.name: Issue created
triggers.determinism_note: Deciding whether an issue is real work is judgment.
triggers.note: An issue-listing tool exists; nothing polls it.

triggers.name: Issue labeled
triggers.determinism_note: Deterministic only while the label itself is the contract.

triggers.name: Dependency update available
triggers.note: Authorizing a security-sensitive bump remains the captain's.

triggers.name: Upstream changes
triggers.determinism_note: A remote sha comparison is exact.
triggers.note: Fleet sync runs once at locked session start. That is a startup sweep, not an event detector.

triggers.name: Benchmark regression detected
triggers.determinism_note: Deterministic only while the threshold is declared.
triggers.note: Without a declared bound only exhaustion is reachable, so a budget is mandatory before this trigger could ever be enabled.

triggers.name: Phase completed
triggers.determinism_note: A worker-authored completion line is a claim, not a verdict.
triggers.note: Status classification and wake dedupe are real, but converting a claim into a verified state needs a model turn.

triggers.name: Evidence becomes available
triggers.idempotency_key: (source id, sequence) with a durable handled acknowledgement
triggers.note: The generic mechanism exists and carries a real durable key, but no sources are registered, so nothing is detected.

triggers.name: Model or provider becomes unavailable
triggers.determinism_note: Choosing among candidates is judgment firstmate owns.
triggers.note: Read at intake inside a model turn, never polled. Whether the capacity stop band covers validation runs is an open captain decision owned by another lane; this register does not answer it.

triggers.name: Required artifact changes
triggers.determinism_note: A content hash comparison is exact.
triggers.note: The check mechanism could detect this today and none is registered, so the capability is real and the detector is absent.

triggers.name: Scheduled external result arrives
triggers.idempotency_key: (source id, sequence) with a durable handled acknowledgement
triggers.note: Same generic mechanism as evidence-becomes-available, with the same zero registered sources.

outside_the_sixteen.name: PR merged
outside_the_sixteen.note: A real detector that is deliberately not counted among the sixteen, because it is not on the canonical enumeration. Counting it is what produced the withdrawn 'two of sixteen' figure; the honest headline is one of sixteen.
